मुंबई में गोविंदा और सुनीता आहूजा का आलीशान घर चर्चा में है। 🏠
इस खूबसूरत घर में 38 साल की यादें और एलीट अंदाज साफ नजर आता है। ✨
सुनीता आहूजा और गोविंदा के इस शानदार आशियाने की झलक फैंस को खूब पसंद आ रही है। ❤️
क्या आपने गोविंदा के इस घर की अंदर की तस्वीरें देखी हैं या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट करके तुरंत बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: EXCLUSIVE: Inside Sunita Ahuja and Govinda’s luxurious home in Mumbai, recounting ‘38 years of memories’ and elegance
ctx.summary:
Sunita Ahuja and  Govinda ’s Mumbai home is a definition of how traditional detailing meets luxury. With an inviting palette of cream and ivory and carefully chosen decorative accents, the home strikes a balance between old-world charm and modern sophistication. 
 As she prepares for Diwali celebrations, here is a closer look at her home and the distinctive design elements that give it character, in an exclusive interaction with Pinkvilla. 
 Inside Sunita Ahuja and Govinda’s home in Mumbai 
 The entrance of the home sets the tone for its classic aesthetic, with a prominent wooden main door featuring vertical slatted detailing. During celebrations, the entrance is further enhanced with traditional decorative elements and festive lighting, creating a welcoming transition into the home. 
 As we enter the living room, it becomes evident that this is one of the most striking spaces in the house. Its interiors revolve around a sophisticated palette of cream, ivory, deep forest green, mustard yellow, and chocolate brown. 
 The walls feature elaborate decorative cornices and layered panel detailing, lending the room a distinctly European character. Rather than relying on wallpaper, the interiors use architectural detailing to create visual interest.
